name: tuned
based_on: the default config's Febrl-style setup with match types chosen from Zingg's match-type reference: TEXT for the space-joined email list (word overlap), EXACT plus NULL_OR_BLANK for single-valued ids, company and city (Zingg treats nulls as matches unless NULL_OR_BLANK is added), FUZZY for the name parts and the full name; a larger labelling budget in the same findTrainingData and label loop
tuning: Match types and the labelling budget were chosen by looking only at the held-out world (seed 20261118); the oracle labels only held-out pairs. Zingg Community has no threshold to tune
proposed_note: none: Zingg Community exposes no match threshold and no review band
